the_kid_childhood: the_kid_childhood, A scruffy 12-year-old boy, lean and dirt-smudged, messy tousled brown hair, intense focused eyes, wearing oversized faded hand-me-down denim overalls and a worn beige cotton shirt, holding a beat-up pawn-shop acoustic guitar with worn edges.
the_kid_early_years: the_kid_early_years, A lean, scruffy 19-year-old young man with tousled dark brown hair, sharp hungry facial features, light stubble, burning ambitious expression, wearing a faded blue denim trucker jacket with rolled sleeves over a plain white t-shirt, beat-up jeans, holding a battered sunburst acoustic guitar with worn wood lacquer.
the_kid_superstar: the_kid_superstar, A wealthy 27-year-old country-rock superstar, slicked dark hair, sharp gaunt cheekbones, haunted hollow dark eyes masking existential dread, dressed in an immaculate embroidered custom black-and-silver satin western suit with pearl-snap buttons, silver tip collar, gold rings on slender fingers, holding a polished custom jet-black acoustic guitar.
the_kid_preacher: the_kid_preacher, A prematurely aged 35-year-old man, gaunt and weathered face, hollow weary eyes burning with solemn stubborn defiance, ragged grey-streaked beard and disheveled hair, wearing a threadbare charcoal preacher's frock coat over a faded dark collarless cotton shirt, carrying a thick battered leather-bound Bible with frayed corners.
the_devil_bluesman: the_devil_bluesman, An enigmatic elderly African-American man with deeply weathered skin, deep knowing wrinkles, sharp predatory grin, uncanny glowing amber eyes that catch light unnaturally, wearing a dusty grey felt fedora tilted low and a wrinkled charcoal pinstripe vintage suit with a loosened dark tie, smoking a wooden tobacco pipe with curling embers.
the_devil_shadow: the_devil_shadow, Character design concept sheet, full body and expressive close-ups. A towering 7-foot tall supernatural shadow figure enveloped in swirling midnight dust, mist, and sulfur embers. An ink-black silhouette manifestation with two piercing glowing red ember eyes and a razor-sharp jagged white tooth grin, holding an ancient massive ledger book bound in cracked, scorched black leather.
the_devil_rider: the_devil_rider, A menacing, colossal motorcycle club enforcer in a heavy scuffed black leather vest cut adorned with a flaming skull crest and iron studs, imposing muscular frame, face obscured in pitch-black shadow under a motorcycle helmet visor, smoking red embers drifting from cracks in his leather chest, wielding heavy rusted iron chains.
the_mother: the_mother, A tired, hardworking 50-year-old rural Southern woman with silver-streaked brown hair tied back in a loose bun, deeply lined gentle face marked by grief and hard farm labor, red-rimmed sorrowful eyes full of maternal concern, wearing a faded floral cotton apron over a modest blue dress.
the_label_man: the_label_man, A slick 45-year-old music industry executive with greased-back black hair greying at the temples, thin sharp mustache, gold-rimmed aviator sunglasses, immaculate tan 1970s polyester suit with wide lapels and silk floral tie, gold wristwatch and pinky ring, smoking an expensive cigar with an arrogant, predatory smirk.
the_old_timer: the_old_timer, A grizzled 70-year-old storyteller and barfly in a dingy roadside dive bar, yellowed white beard stubble, weathered wrinkled skin, faded vintage trucker cap pulled low over rheumy, haunted eyes, wearing a worn flannel work shirt over a dirty undershirt, gripping a glass tumbler of cheap amber whiskey on a scuffed wooden bar counter.
